co_independence_pass.name: Independence Pass
co_independence_pass.note: Sources say summer and early autumn / late spring to early fall, but name no climbing months; road closed ~Halloween to Memorial Day.

nv_black_velvet_canyon.name: Black Velvet Canyon
nv_black_velvet_canyon.note: Red Rocks guide names Mar-May and Sep-Nov; Snell Press says Oct-early Apr for the park; MP posters say mid/late April and October are best for shaded Black Velvet. Shaded canyon so shoulder seasons extend.

qc_trois_rives.name: Trois-Rives
qc_trois_rives.note: No source found stating rock climbing months.

wv_new_river_gorge_proper.name: New River Gorge Proper
wv_new_river_gorge_proper.note: NPS: best months usually late April to mid-June and mid-September to late October; other sources agree spring and fall are best (summer hot/humid).

co_north_cheyenne_canyon_2.name: North Cheyenne Canyon
co_north_cheyenne_canyon_2.note: Sources say spring and fall (or late spring to early fall) with no months named; MP page gives none.

tn_tennessee_wall_the.name: The Tennessee Wall
tn_tennessee_wall_the.note: One guide: best Oct-May (SW face too hot in summer); Mountain Project: Sept-June prime, terrific winter crag. Took shared Oct-May. Hunting-season closures apply.

co_reba_boulders.name: Reba Boulders
co_reba_boulders.note: Only season words (spring and fall) for Unaweep/Grand Junction; nothing month-naming or specific to Nine Mile.

nm_el_rito_sport_area.name: El Rito Sport Area
nm_el_rito_sport_area.note: Only 'spring or fall' with no months; raptor closures in spring on trad area.

wv_seneca_rocks.name: Seneca Rocks
wv_seneca_rocks.note: Spring through fall with Sept-Oct peak; search summaries gave Mar-Oct / Mar-Nov windows; winter only on warm days. Broad window, peak is Sep-Oct.

co_southie_area.name: Southie Area
co_southie_area.note: Only season words (spring and fall) for the Unaweep/Grand Junction region; no months.

vt_top_of_the_notch_boulders.name: Top of the Notch Boulders
vt_top_of_the_notch_boulders.note: Madboulder: spring and fall; others late spring to early fall/summer; no months named. Rt 108 closes in winter.

az_christopher_creek_gorge.name: Christopher Creek Gorge
az_christopher_creek_gorge.note: Only canyoneering-oriented months (May-Jul, Sep); sources contradict on July; no climbing season found.

co_horsetooth_reservoir.name: Horsetooth Reservoir
co_horsetooth_reservoir.note: Madboulder: best Mar-May and Sep-Nov; Outdoor Project spring/summer/fall; ClimbingAway outlier Jan-Jul. Summer hot, early/late day only.

nm_palomas_peak.name: Palomas Peak
nm_palomas_peak.note: Friends of the Sandias: climbing season truly year round (Sandia range); ClimbingAway lists all months for Palomas; snow on approach in winter possible.

pa_governor_stable.name: Governor Stable
pa_governor_stable.note: HELD by reviewer: landowner access window, not a climbing season. This is the landowner ACCESS window (open ~Dec 21/mid-Dec to Jul 31 each year), not a conditions season; climbing is only allowed then. Older sources said Jan 1-Aug 31.

az_pit_aka_le_petit_verdon_the.name: Pit (aka Le Petit Verdon), The
az_pit_aka_le_petit_verdon_the.note: Sources say year-round or Jun-Sep (a hiking-site estimate) - contradictory; nesting closure applies.

id_mortal_earth.name: Mortal Earth
id_mortal_earth.note: Only anecdotal visits (late May-June, Sept, early Oct); no authoritative months.

nc_west_side_boulders.name: West Side Boulders
nc_west_side_boulders.note: Reviewer: Rumbling Bald window (round 3). Rumbling Bald system: MP says prime time is mid-winter; hike guide names Nov-Mar; another says fall-spring with winter best. Took Nov-Mar for the whole system.
